audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill/Yorick/Yorick/Skill/Skill/Yorick/Yorick while every content why says Yorick level 1, Sett from level 2 through first item, Yorick at 2+ items — which is also the packet chart.
audit.why: Sett wins this lane at 55.09% over 2093 games. Mourning Mist out-ranges him at level 1, but from Facebreaker onward the isolated duel is Sett's until the Maiden and a full Walker pack arrive.
audit.corrected: Yorick / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Yorick.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why claimed Sett is the strongest level-1 auto-trader here, and phases[6].why credited Sterak's in Yorick's row.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is a 700-range armour-shredding mark that speeds his Walkers at you; Sett has nothing at that range. At two items Eulogy of the Isles (100s at rank 3) puts a second fighter on the field, which no shield item answers.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their real owners with the range and cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] told the player to 'hold your dash-pull to break out' of Dark Procession, and no cooldowns appeared anywhere (a flagged packet defect).
audit.why: Sett has no dash in his kit — Facebreaker is a pull and The Show Stopper is a carry-and-slam. Dark Procession is destructible terrain on 20/18/16/14/12s, which is exactly the flagged terrain-cuts-retreat case: the answer is Flash, or breaking the wall, not a dash he does not have. Last Rites also carries both the heal and autoReset flags.
audit.corrected: Dash claim removed and replaced with the Flash rule; W and E cooldowns and the Last Rites reset/heal now stated.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Yorick on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Mourning Mist (E) reaches 700 and marks you for the Mist Walkers, so level 1 is his. Take the melee CS and give him nothing until Facebreaker is up.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Dark Procession (Cage) and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles is 100s late and the Maiden fights for him — two items in, his summons out-damage anything a Grit shield absorbs in a siege.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession (Cage): matchup-defining — Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Track it before every engage. - Yorick Dark Procession: Summons a ring of walls that traps enemies (or himself) inside. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Yorick Dark Procession (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — it is destructible terrain, and you have no dash, so hold Flash for the wall rather than the damage. - Mourning Mist (E): 12s to 8s, 700 range — it cuts armour and marks you for the Walkers.

edits.before: Once you have E Facebreaker you can pull Yorick and W him hard, but clear his Mist Walkers first with Q autos or they chunk you while you commit. A full Grit bar W plus E turns any short trade in your favour before his ghouls stack up.
edits.after: Clear the Mist Walkers with Knuckle Down first or they chunk you mid-commit. Last Rites (Q) is an auto reset that heals him, so the wind-up is your cue — and buy Executioner's before the trades go long. Then pull and cash a full Grit bar.

edits.before: R The Show Stopper lets you isolate Yorick from his ghouls and Maiden — pull him past his minions and ult him down. His W cage can trap you, so hold your dash-pull to break out rather than walking into it.
edits.after: The Show Stopper isolates Yorick from his Walkers and the Maiden — carry him past his own minions and slam him there. Dark Procession is destructible walls and you have no dash, so keep Flash for the cage, not the damage.

notes: Sett has no dash anywhere in his kit; one field told the player to use a 'dash-pull' to escape Dark Procession. The content whys already matched the packet chart — only the side/rating tokens and two full-layer strings disagreed.
